content.trans: 所以它可以说有点负面。

content.text: Well, interesting phrases on Fluency Builder today.
content.trans: 今天，有趣的话题在 Fluent Builder 上。

content.text: I think it's time for us to listen to this dialogue for one last time.
content.trans: 我认为我们有必要再次倾听这次对话。

content.text: And we'll be back in a little bit.
content.trans: 接下来我们会回到这里。

content.text: Steven, good to see you, brother.
I've been better, but it's great to be home.
content.trans: 我过得更好了，但在这里真是太好了。

content.text: All she ever does is talk about you or little boy, the event of the United States.
content.trans: 所有她都只是谈论你或者小男孩，美国的事件。

content.text: I can't wait to see you.
Well, Nisha and I are expecting.
content.trans: 好的，Nisha 和我正在期待。

content.text: You'll have another nephew or niece soon.
content.trans: 您很快就会有一个侄子或侄女。

content.text: You two are great together, you know.
content.trans: 你俩相处得很好，你知道。

content.text: You have such a beautiful family.
content.trans: 您有这样的一个美丽的家庭。

content.text: I hope that one day I can have that.
content.trans: 我希望有一天我能有它。

content.text: I mean, everything was set here for you to marry Shalini.
content.trans: 我指的是，一切都为你与沙利尼结婚而准备好了。

content.text: You know, she's still planning after you.
I don't think she'll ever get over you.

content.trans: 在中文中，"What are you talking about?" 翻译成普通话是 "你在说什么呢？" 或者更简洁地表达为 "你在说些什么呢？"。

content.text: How could she be in love with me?
I can go through with it even though she's a great woman.
content.trans: 我也可以按照她的标准去完成它，尽管她是一位杰出的女性。

content.text: No, I left my heart in the United States.
content.trans: 是的，我留在美国的心里。

content.text: I just hope Veronica is happy.
Everyone here thinks so highly of you.
content.trans: 每个人在这里都这么评价你。

content.text: They'll be girls throwing themselves at you.
You can marry anyone you want.
content.trans: 你可以娶任何人你想要的。

content.text: I don't want to marry anyone.
Steven, my baby, how are you?
content.trans: 你好，我的宝贝，你怎么样？

content.text: They didn't those Americans feed you.
content.trans: 他们没有让你吃美国人。

content.text: By the way, there is a girl here waiting for you.
content.trans: 你好，这里有一个女孩等你。

content.text: How do you know where I live?
I waited for you at the airport, but you never showed.
content.trans: 我在机场等你，但你从不出现。

content.text: I also have some little secrets that I haven't told you about, but we can discuss that later.
content.trans: 我还有些小秘密，还没有告诉你，但我们可以稍后讨论。

content.text: I realized that I was just scared, scared of how much I love you and of the commitment
content.trans: 我意识到，我只是害怕自己有多么爱你，并且对承诺的恐惧。

content.text: Now there's something I want to ask you.
content.trans: 现在我想问你一些事情。

content.text: Steven, who are you marrying me?
I now declare you husband and wife.
And we went from them meeting casually by a bike accident.
content.trans: 我们从他们随意相遇，靠自行车发生事故。

content.text: Then it turned out that she was angry.
He was being strained with all of these secret trips to save people.
content.trans: 他正承受着这些秘密的长途旅行，以拯救人们。

content.text: We went a lot of different ways.
content.trans: 我们走了很多不同的路。

content.text: Now we need to think of a new drama, a new soap opera or novel.
content.trans: 现在我们需要考虑一个新的戏剧、一部新的情节剧或一本小说。

content.text: Maybe we should open it up.

content.trans: 在中文中，"What did you like?" 可以翻译为：
在中文中，"What didn't you like?" 翻译成普通话是 "你不喜欢什么？" 或者更简洁地表达为 "你喜欢什么？"。

content.text: What kind of genre are you interested in?
There's tons of different kinds of stories we could tell.
content.trans: 我们能讲述的不同的故事太多了。

content.text: Maybe we can do something scary, like a thriller or horror.
content.trans: 可能我们可以做些吓人的事情，比如惊悚片或恐怖片。

content.text: I'm a big fan of sci-fi.
Maybe we can do something sci-fi.
content.trans: 可能我们可以做点科幻。

content.text: We can do a comedy, something like friends.
content.trans: 我们能做喜剧，比如朋友。

content.text: Listeners, why don't you give us your input?
content.trans: 听众，为什么你不给我们你的意见？

content.text: Tell us what series you would like next, what type of series.
content.trans: 请告诉我您想看的下一集，是哪一类系列。

content.text: Maybe we said drama, sci-fi, action.
content.trans: 也许我们说悬疑、科幻、动作。

content.text: And please get in touch with us.
Leave comments and questions at our website, www.englishpod.com.
content.trans: 在我们的网站 www.englishpod.com 上留下评论和问题。

content.text: We like to check those and answer you.
content.trans: 我们喜欢检查这些，并回答你。

content.text: Get in touch with us and have a great day.
content.trans: 与我们取得联系，祝你一天愉快！
